An '''iron chestplate''' is a [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, crafted from eight [[iron ingot]]s. Its {{Value|Iron Chestplate|armor}} armor points are two more than the [[copper chestplate]].

=== Loot ===

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives {{Value|Iron Chestplate|armor}} armor and has {{Value|Iron Chestplate|durability}} durability (vanilla: 240). Iron armor has 350 durability per piece and the vanilla armor values, 15 points for the full set. It is the base for [[Steel equipment|steel armor]].

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into one iron ingot in a [[blast furnace]], and takes [[steel alloy]] at a [[smithing table]].
